description: Shows you the drawing as it is printed: a picture of a page or component, or of part of it, and which coordinates it covers. Use it to check what you drew, and "area" to look closer at a corner or a room.

area.description: The part to show, in drawing millimetres. Leave it out for everything on the page.

page.description: Id of a page or component. Leave it out for the one being worked on.

name: view_drawing
